column1: # Urdu words that espeak-ng's `ur` voice mispronounces, respelled with diacritics
# (zabar َ, zer ِ, pesh ُ, shadd ّ) or a closer letter so it produces the right
# phonemes. Used in training (prepare_dataset.py --lexicon) and at synthesis
# (synth.py, by default), so the model learns and speaks the same sounds.
#   python -c "from piper.phonemize_espeak import EspeakPhonemizer as P; print(P().phonemize('ur', 'صُبح'))"
